There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor analysis: Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model presents a significant strategic challenge to traditional automotive sales structures. By eliminating dealership markups, they can undercut competitors on price, which may erode our market share if we rely on similar pricing tiers. Furthermore, their direct engagement allows for real-time data collection on consumer preferences, enabling faster product iterations and more targeted marketing. To counter this, we should consider enhancing our own digital sales channels, improving transparency in pricing, and leveraging our existing dealership network for superior after-sales service and customer experience, which DTC models often struggle to match.
